I sat down with Shannon Jean, who's built and sold over 10 companies, and we talked all about the art of reselling. He shared how he made $557K net profit selling luxury handbags, and why building systems is the real game—no matter what category you're in. We covered how he connects directly with eBay and Poshmark execs to avoid account issues, how he uses liquidation sites like B-Stock, and why category only matters 30%—the rest is all systems and execution.

You can find Shannon Jean on X ( https://x.com/shannonjean ). He’s also the cohost of the @businessbrainshow  podcast, which you can find at businessbrain.show
